name: Modern Warfare 4
description: Modern Warfare 4 枪包。【开发预览版】正式版以加密发布包为准。
descriptionEn: Modern Warfare 4 gun pack. [Dev Preview] The official release is the encrypted pack.

guns.name: 沙漠之鹰
guns.description: 后坐力专治手抖 开一枪之后 不是目标躺下 就是你抬头看天花板
guns.descriptionEn: Recoil therapy for shaky hands After one shot either the target is down or youre looking at the ceiling

guns.name: M16A1 突击步枪
guns.description: 越战老兵 退休返聘 点射能不能打满三发 全看它今天心情如何
guns.descriptionEn: A Vietnam veteran called back to work Whether you get all three rounds depends on its mood today

guns.name: AK-47 突击步枪
guns.description: 做工粗糙 声音洪亮 泥里滚三圈照样响 你可以质疑它的精度 但别质疑它会不会开火
guns.descriptionEn: Rough loud and still works after three rolls in the mud Doubt its accuracy if you like never doubt that it fires

guns.name: SCAR-H 战斗步枪
guns.description: 比利时设计的特种作战步枪 5.56 口径 人机工效优秀 就是贵
guns.descriptionEn: Belgian special-operations rifle in 5.56 Ergonomic to a fault pricey by design

guns.name: 精密国际 AWP 狙击步枪
guns.description: 一枪一个 打不中是网卡 与本人枪法无关
guns.descriptionEn: One shot one kill if you miss blame the ping

guns.name: MRAD 狙击步枪
guns.description: 栓动一响 全场安静 唯一的问题是拉栓那半秒 你比目标还紧张
guns.descriptionEn: One shot then total silence The only thing slower than the bolt is your heartbeat while you cycle it

guns.name: HK416D 突击步枪
guns.description: 德国工艺 精密得连你买不起它的理由都算得很准 可靠性与价格成正比 与你的钱包成反比
guns.descriptionEn: German engineering precise enough to calculate exactly why you cant afford it Reliability is proportional to its price and inversely proportional to your wallet

guns.name: HK G3 战斗步枪
guns.description: 滚柱闭锁的德国大铁块 精度靠重量压出来 后坐力全靠你别抖
guns.descriptionEn: Roller delayed German steel Accuracy paid for in kilograms and recoil paid for in wrist

guns.name: HK MK23 手枪
guns.description: 消音手枪里的老大哥 声音小到队友都以为你没开枪 直到敌人倒下
guns.descriptionEn: The quiet big brother of pistols So quiet your squad thinks you never fired until someone drops

guns.name: RPK 轻机枪
guns.description: 卡拉什尼科夫班用机枪 一根长枪管加个大弹鼓 压枪压得住就是移动火力点
guns.descriptionEn: Kalashnikov squad machine gun A long barrel and a fat drum hold the recoil and you are a walking firebase

guns.name: M700 狙击步枪
guns.description: 雷明顿 M700 旋转后拉枪机 一发一中 拉栓的手感比命中更上瘾
guns.descriptionEn: Remington M700 bolt action One shot one kill The bolt throw is more addictive than the hit

guns.name: FN FAL 战斗步枪
guns.description: 号称 自由世界的右手 问题是这只手换弹匣比你想好下一个借口还快
guns.descriptionEn: The right arm of the free world whose reload is faster than your next excuse

guns.name: MCX SPEAR LT 突击步枪
guns.description: 枪管护木全模块化 换个零件就像换了把枪 短行程活塞保证它不挑食 唯一挑的是你家里有没有矿
guns.descriptionEn: Fully modular short stroke piston rifle Swap a handguard and it is a different gun It only jams on your aim

guns.name: HK437 突击步枪
guns.description: 模块化短管步枪 手感利落 近中距离都够用
guns.descriptionEn: A compact modular rifle with clean handling for close and mid-range fights

guns.name: AK-74M 突击步枪
guns.description: 从雨林到海湾 再到雪原 换了折叠枪托和聚合物护木的老兵 脾气一点没改
guns.descriptionEn: From the jungle to the gulf and on to the snow A veteran with a folding stock and polymer furniture Same temper as ever

guns.name: HK G28 精确射手步枪
guns.description:
7.62 口径的精确射手步枪 精度换来的是一枪一停 别指望它替你压枪
§7感谢大佬神梦星辰提供的模型
guns.descriptionEn:
A 7.62 marksman rifle Accuracy paid for with a slower trigger It won't hold steady for you
§7Model courtesy of ShenMengXingChen

guns.name: URGI
guns.description: 14.5 英寸 M4 平台 换成 Geissele 自由浮置护木 每一发都比原厂 M4A1 更干净 但它终究还是 5.56
guns.descriptionEn: A 14.5-inch M4-pattern upper on a Geissele free-float rail Every shot feels crisper than a stock M4A1 but it is still only 5.56
